sections.description:
Give your customers a premium way to personalize your products.
Kickflip helps you sell custom products faster — with a seamless buying experience that boosts sales, raises average order value, and strengthens your brand.

Turn customization into a growth lever

Your customers want products made just for them. Kickflip makes it easy to deliver that — without slowing down your business.
Build an interactive customizer that feels native to your brand, shows every choice in real time, and helps you sell more with confidence.

Video: Unleash the power of product customization with Kickflip →

Built for performance and experience

Real-time previews

Let customers see exactly what they’re getting — in every color, angle, and option.

Dynamic pricing

Instant pricing updates as customers make custom selections of upsell options

Live coloring

Show live price updates as customers add or change options, removing surprises at checkout.

Lightning-fast load times

A smooth experience from desktop to mobile. No waiting, no lag — just instant results.

Advanced logic & rules

Guide every customer through a seamless flow. Hide, show, or combine options dynamically to prevent mistakes and save time.

Print-ready files

Automatically generate high-resolution files to speed up production and reduce errors.

Bulk Orders & B2B ready

Let customers place multi-item or volume orders easily, with built-in support for quotes and complex pricing.

Explore all features →

Launch in weeks, not months

Kickflip’s intuitive drag-and-drop builder gets your first product live fast — no code required.
You can connect directly with WooCommerce, or use our API for a custom integration. Our help docs, video tutorials, and human support team are always there when you need them.

A powerful backend that scales with your business

Manage every order, option, and design from one place.
Kickflip automatically syncs with your store so you can track products, access customer selections, and send print-ready files to production in seconds.

Trusted by growing brands

Brands use Kickflip to create premium experiences that convert — and to build the kind of products customers love to share. Deliver personalization that looks great, feels effortless, and drives revenue.

Exceptional support, whenever you need it

Questions, setup help, or troubleshooting — our Customer Success team is here for you. Reach us by live chat, email, or video call, and get quick answers from real people who know the platform inside out.

Why merchants choose Kickflip

  • Delivers a premium experience customers love.
  • Gets you selling custom products in weeks, not months.
  • Offers a robust backend that grows with your business.
  • Supported by a real team, always ready to help.

View demo store →
sections.installation:
1. Download and activate the Kickflip plugin.
  2. Create your Kickflip account using the Dashboard link in your WordPress Dashboard Plugins page.
  3. Start building your first product configurator.
sections.faq:
Do I need to code to use Kickflip?

No. Kickflip is a visual builder — you can launch your first customizable product without writing a single line of code.

Can I use my own domain name?

Yes. Kickflip can be easily integrated within your own woocommerce website or online store.

Do I need to provide my credit card to sign up?

No. After your free trial, you will be asked to pick a plan and provide your billing information.

Do I need to pay for hosting?

No. Hosting and bandwidth are included with every plan.

Can I change my plan anytime?

Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan anytime.

Can I cancel my account anytime?

Yes. You can cancel your account anytime.

How do you calculate the transaction fee?

The transaction fee applies only on orders processed and confirmed through Kickflip.
